purpose: Isolate GAE lambda in shared PPO while keeping reward, discount, inputs, action support and initialization fixed.
control_reuse: Reuse the pre-registered PPO arm after its coordinator completes. Do not alter or restart its source, models, logs, or evaluations.
primary_contrast: For every physical metric: (lambda 0.99 trained minus own initial) minus (lambda 0.95 trained minus own initial).
initial_control: Require exact complete initial policy tensors, matching gamma, identical neutral Gaussian actor, and identical deterministic initial physical metrics.
checkpoint_selection: First checkpoint at or above 50k within one 2560-slot rollout; final at or above 100k. Report both arms and all checkpoints, not the best intermediate result.
resource_policy: One added simulator worker; the existing SAC/PPO and exploration coordinators continue unchanged. Local use stays below five workers.
limitations: One exploratory training seed and twenty reused development worlds; multiple training seeds and held-out validation are required before a performance claim.
GAE lambda controls temporal-difference residual weighting, not a hard planning horizon. A learned critic can convey longer-term consequences.
Higher lambda may increase variance. The two-world diagnostic does not prove a credit-assignment defect or predict that higher lambda wins.
The comparison reuses an already registered control from a different study; it is not an additional independent control replicate.
100k live transitions is a screening budget, not a convergence claim. Exact live counts, optimizer steps and curves are retained.
Neither gamma nor the native reward, reward scale, progress shaping, action mapping, observation scaling, route guidance or filters change.
Reserved streams 20301/20302 and official seed42 remain unused.
